title: ClinicalVis: Supporting Clinical Task-Focused Design Evaluation A Visualization-Based Prototype System to Explore the Interaction of Healthcare Providers and Electronic Healthcare Records
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of a visualization system (ClinicalVis) for clinical task planning, measuring metrics like usability, accuracy, confidence, and time-to-decision, and comparing it to a baseline system. While the context of patient care inherently involves ethical considerations, the study does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its research or the system itself.
